name: timeline
props: { key?, title, description?, time?, status?, icon?, avatar?, image?, images?, tags?, links?, content? } per event.
Filled with a drawn check · pulsing · hollow on a dotted track · red with a drawn ✕.
cart, package, truck, home, rocket, bug, star, chat, tag, user, or your own glyph in a larger dot (done/failed get a mini check/✕ badge).
Avatar (initials fallback) instead of a dot.
Photo under the text, rounded, fades in when loaded (16:9 by default).
Photo gallery: 1-up at its ratio, 2-up side by side, 3-up one large + two stacked (+N for more). Rounded, fades in.
Small accent chips under the text.
Tappable accent links under the text.
Rich content under the description: a card, quote, tags or buttons.
Roomy rows · small dots on one line · each event on a card (current one tinted) · renders its own scroll view and fills the line as you scroll (give it a height).
Done / current dots and the filled line.
Draw a check in done dots.
Staggered entrance + connector fill, or the scroll-driven fill (off with reduce motion: everything shows filled).
Colour behind the rail — fills hollow dots and mini badge cut-outs.
scroll: shown above the timeline inside the scroll view.
scroll: shown below the timeline inside the scroll view.
scroll: the scroll view's content container.
Root style — for variant="scroll" this is the scroll view, so set a height.
